title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, preserves method/memory, self-critiques route quality, compiles context and work, lets identical fresh workers self-assign distinct safe opportunities, converges evidence through explicit authority, and regenerates useful next waves with decreasing human coordination.
human_goal: The human normally sends `.` to a bound parent and, only when durable demand justifies it, opens N fresh chats with one identical worker bootstrap. The human does not remember plans, number workers, route tasks, carry returns, detect every strategic drift, or design each next batch.
success_conditions: Fresh parent reincarnation without transcript restatement.
Bound dot executes useful work from durable state and persists changed frontier before reply.
Planner/Compiler turns goals/returns/incidents/proposals/critic findings into dependency-aware opportunities.
Multiple identical workers atomically claim distinct work and expose claim/STARTED/RETURN/DONE evidence.
Generic stale/retry/supersession prevents vanished workers from blocking progress.
Context Fabric compiles role/task L0/L1/L2 context with receipts instead of requiring bulk repository reading.
Validator/Steward reconcile evidence while Current/Human Accepted/Served remain separate.
Fresh critics are triggered by evidence/risk and materially affect or falsify routes when warranted.
At least two worker generations are generated without human redesign of the batch.
Parent can disappear mid-campaign and a fresh successor continues.
non_goals: Optimizing Live cosmetics before core metabolism.
Maximizing busy chats regardless of useful durable value.
Making worker completion equivalent to authority.
current_frontier: Recovery workers for BIG09 and BIG13 are DONE with durable candidate returns. Final 18-domain integration/coverage/authority audit is now actionable and is the first mandatory step of the next dot. In parallel, self-assigning worker verification, progress metrics, critic cadence, worker-depth, Context Fabric, recursive Planner and event-loop work are represented by active queues. The next parent cycle must integrate/verify/critique/compile a new READY frontier and derive the useful worker count rather than telling the human to wait or blindly open a fixed number.
next_human_action: Send `.` in the bound parent. That cycle must execute NEXT_DOT_EXECUTION_PACKAGE_V1 and then, if useful capacity remains, return one reusable `/wc` command plus an evidence-derived count (up to 8, not automatically 8).
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, campaign state, invariants, negative knowledge, roots, queues/claims/runs/returns, integration, verification or frontier must be durable before relying on transcript memory.
authority_law: This object orchestrates and integrates candidate evidence under its scoped role; worker output never self-promotes. Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served remain distinct authorities and promotion requires the correct evidence/owner path.
